flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/NoticeSearch/form/NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx (fields id_no, notice_no, summon_no, warrant_no), pages/NoticeSearch/hook/{useSearchParams.tsx,useSearch.ts} (getNoticesByWA, getNoticesBySummon), utils/config/env.ts (isAPIFound), pages/Notice/form/NoticeOccurences.tsx (tab commented out in Form.tsx and GroupPreview.tsx). ocmsadminapi api-authorization.properties (/v1/warrantofarrest). No search dedicated to the WA database, no house visit date filter, and the warrantofarrest controller is not in the repos
note: The story status is blank in stories.json (requirement not given), so it is traced normally. This 1-point story asks to search the WA list records by ID, notice no, warrant no, summons no and a house visit date range. The staff portal has a generic Notice Search screen with id_no, notice_no, summon_no and warrant_no fields (NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx), but it searches notices (eVON), not the outstanding-WA ID database from OCMS34.1, which does not exist. The warrant_no search calls resource warrantofarrest (useSearch.ts:68-77) but its controller is not in the repos (it only appears in api-authorization.properties:23), so the real result cannot be verified from the repo; the summon_no search only runs when isAPIFound (STAGING/LOCAL, env.ts:11; useSearchParams.tsx:206-208). The Notice Occurrences component has a quickSearch on notice_no, vehicle_no, summon_no, warrant_no (NoticeOccurences.tsx:135-148) but its tab is commented out (Form.tsx:219-226; GroupPreview.tsx:127-132) and its resource has no controller. There is no house visit date range filter; date_of_visit is only a display field in that unmounted component (NoticeOccurences.tsx:230-233). Because this generic screen is not what the story names, the four parameters are rated Sebagian. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Claim only partially: generic search fields exist on Notice Search, but it is not a search of the outstanding-WA database and there is no house visit date filter. Depends on OCMS34.1, which has no code

steps.step: The Tagging officer opens a search screen for the list of IDs with outstanding warrants
steps.detail: There is no search screen dedicated to the WA list. What exists is the generic Notice Search (NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx), which searches notices. The WA database from OCMS34.1 does not exist, so there is nothing to search. case-insensitive grep across the six repos (warrant, workorder, work_order, tagging, visit, enforcement, bailiff, service provider, matrix) finds no entity, controller, cron, or service for this feature.

Notice Search has an id_no field (NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx:542) sent as params idNo (useSearchParams.tsx:530) and it searches notices. But it searches notice data, not outstanding-WA list records, so only Sebagian.
The notice_no field exists on Notice Search (NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx:64; useSearchParams.tsx:167). Same as ID: it searches notices, not WA list records.

The warrant_no field exists (NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx:458) and getNoticesByWA calls resource warrantofarrest with a warrant_no[$regex] filter (useSearch.ts:68-77; used in useSearchParams.tsx:210-211). No warrantofarrest controller/entity exists in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi or thirdpartyapi (only /v1/warrantofarrest in api-authorization.properties:23), so whether this search really returns data cannot be verified from the repo. The result is notices, not WA list records.

The summon_no field exists (NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx:438) but its search only runs when isAPIFound (useSearchParams.tsx:206-208), which is true only on STAGING or LOCAL (env.ts:11), so on PRO/UAT/DEV the summons search is skipped. The real server ENV value cannot be verified from the repo. It searches notices, not WA list records.

steps.step: Search by house visit date range
steps.detail: There is no house visit date range field or query. The nearest date range on Notice Search is notice_date_start/end (NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx:471,498), the notice date, not a visit date. date_of_visit is only a display field in the Notice Occurrences component (NoticeOccurences.tsx:230-233), whose tab is commented out, not a filter.

steps.step: Records matching the search input are shown as more specific WA records
steps.detail: Notice Search results are a notice list, not WA records (no work order, visit, address). The WA type (Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts:1-40) is not used to display results; the only warrant grid is Notice Occurrences (NoticeOccurences.tsx:69), whose tab is commented out (Form.tsx:219-226; GroupPreview.tsx:127-132), whose resource is only set on STAGING/LOCAL, and offencenoticeoccurrences has no controller in the repos.
